name: recurve
description: Recurve monorepo: marketing site, dApp, docs, indexer API, fund runner.

scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:api
scripts.build:site: python3 site/build/zh.py && npm run build:docs && npm run build:app
scripts.build:contracts: cd protocol && forge build && cd .. && node scripts/export-contracts.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix runner run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix runner test && python3 docs/build/test_deployments.py && node --test scripts/serve-site.test.mjs scripts/launch.test.mjs
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix runner install
